title: EDG Community Update: Week of October 24th, 2022
body:
## **Highlights**

- Community validator KDPnetstake found one more [bug on the Beresheet v4.0.1 testnet which is now fixed by Remz in the new v4.0.2 release](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/pull/39). v4.0.2 node release is not mandatory if your node(s) are already on the v4.0.1 release.
- Spotlight thread: [The Merge vs The Switch](https://twitter.com/EdgewareDAO/status/1585191157931573248)
- All the Validators, RPC infrastructure providers, Exchanges and Ecosystem Projects are requested to upgrade their node(s) to the [release v4.0.1](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v4.0.1) or [higher](https://github.com/edgeware-network/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v4.0.2).
- Upcoming Activities/Events: [Valorant Gaming Tournament](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/6514-edggaming-tournament) and [Reddit Meme Competition](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/7259-reddit-meme-competition).

## **Ecosystem Updates**

- Upcoming launch: Edgeverse iOS wallet by Bharathcoorg (to be launched around the first week of November.)
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the '[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-oct-23/)'.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcome to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink's oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)'s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
